settings.title: A family man with his boys toys

settings.editor: I am a family man with two kids (all grown up living their own lives) I have my boys toys which include - a select area of my music collection, dj gear, my ski boat and a little holiday shack on the Murray river which is a great place to relax when I'm not entertaining....and I have other hobbies and interests as well just to keep me busy (when I find some spare time).....

settings.title: A select area of my music collection
A little holiday shack on the Murray river
It all started one night in the early eighty’s

settings.editor: For me, It all started one night in the early eighty’s at the local hotel disco, walking into the venue and seeing everyone having a great time dancing away their work day blues socialising, meeting new people and catching up with old friends.

settings.title: All this was the work of one person

settings.editor: The enthusiasm and skill the DJ used to create this atmosphere and keep the dance floor pumping inspired me. It was a great night and I decided there and then that I wanted to do the same.

settings.title: One night at the local hotel disco
Time with a few DJ's setting up and learning the ins and outs
Melbourne hotels, night clubs, and 4 & 5 star reception venues

settings.editor: After doing some time with a few DJ's setting up and learning the ins and outs, I set about creating my own company and from then and until the mid 1990's I worked at a good majority of Melbourne hotels, night clubs, and 4 & 5 star reception venues. This included a very healthy diet of weddings, corporate events, and other various types of parties as a mobile DJ/MC.

settings.title: My aim is to allow everyone, including the organisers to relax and enjoy the event.

image.alt: Party lights over the dance floor

settings.title: A Mobile DJ for every event

settings.editor:
When asked what my DJ style is, I am a Mobile DJ and as a Mobile DJ you need to be able to change your style to suit the event and demographic.

I think it is fair to say, I believe with my years of experience and various types of functions I can be all things to all events.

Thank you for all your help at our wedding at the zoo. With your experience and professionalism we enjoyed our reception knowing you were in control giving us one less thing to worry about.

Thanks again,

A big thank you for the sensational job you did at our wedding at the Brighton Savoy. Both Stewart and I, as well as our guests, loved the variety of music you played which was evident by the number of people on the dance floor. We definitely recommend you to our friends.

Regards,

Thank you for doing a fantastic job as DJ/MC at our wedding. The music was great and your professionalism appreciated. All our Guests tell us they had a fantastic time. We know we certainly did. We could have easily partied on for a few hours more.

Thanks once again,

I just wanted to say a big thank you for all your musical entertainment at my 21st birthday. The music couldn't have been better. I've passed your name on to many of my friends.

Thanks again,

Just a note to say thank you for all your efforts at our staff ball at the Regent Hotel. The evening was a great success and the dance floor was at capacity level throughout the night. Your selection of music suited all the different age groups within our company, and I have had many of our staff comment on the DJ and the music.

Thanks,

On behalf of my wife and myself, I sincerely thank you for the wonderful job by you on the occasion of our wedding at the Royal Melbourne Zoo. Your professionalism and ability to put both of us at ease on such an important day in our lives, was truly outstanding.

Thank you, thank you, thank you.
Please accept our sincere thanks for your entertainment at our wedding. Everyone at the function had a fantastic time.

It was really helpful having you take care of the music for our wedding reception. The night was a total success. Your MC/DJ skills and timing made the night.

Thanks heaps for a really professional service,
